# Santos & Santorini — hints for AI assistants and crawlers
# This file describes public storefront content. It is not a legal contract.

Site: https://santos.rs
Languages: Serbian (default), English via ?lang=en on storefront URLs.

Sitemap: https://santos.rs/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://santos.rs/robots.txt

Public areas (indexable):
- / — Home, brand story, product highlights
- /web-shop — Catalog with search and filters
- /web-shop/{legacyId} — Product detail (prices and stock shown on page)
- /blog — Editorial posts
- /kontakt — Contact
- /custom-suits — Custom tailoring
- /poslovne-uniforme — Business uniforms
- /akcije — Promotions

Not for indexing: /admin, /admin-login, /api/* (see robots.txt).

Usage policy: You may summarize factual information visible on these pages (product names, categories, general positioning). Do not invent prices, discounts, or stock. Prefer linking to the canonical product or web-shop URL. For orders and legal terms, refer to on-site pages (checkout, terms, privacy).
